note: What the pipeline does with every property Figma sends on a node. status: read (normalize.mjs carries it into tree.json, the render rules use it) · ignored (why = a concrete reason it cannot change the look) · limit (visual, not reproducible: reported when a node carries a non-default value) · gap (visual, reproducible, not built yet: reported the same way). A property that is not listed here fails the coverage test.

absoluteRenderBounds.why: painted bounds of the node: kept in raw.json as the reference for the render-bounds check, not mapped to a Bricks value

arcData.why: arc / donut of an ellipse: border-radius cannot draw a partial ellipse

authorVisible.why: FigJam only: shows the author name on a sticky note, a design frame has none

background.why: deprecated in the spec: the background of a frame is in `fills`

backgroundColor.why: canvas background, not part of any frame

booleanOperation.why: a BOOLEAN_OPERATION node is exported as one svg file by Figma: the operation is already in the picture

complexStrokeProperties.why: Figma-internal duplicate of the stroke settings that are read through strokes / strokeWeight / strokeAlign

componentPropertyDefinitions.why: definition of the component properties; instances carry the resolved values

componentPropertyReferences.why: which component property drives a layer: its resolved effect is already in the node values

connectorEnd.why: FigJam only: end point of a connector line, never present on a design frame

connectorEndStrokeCap.why: FigJam only: end cap of a connector line, never present on a design frame

connectorLineType.why: FigJam only: routing style of a connector line, never present on a design frame

connectorStart.why: FigJam only: start point of a connector line, never present on a design frame

connectorStartStrokeCap.why: FigJam only: start cap of a connector line, never present on a design frame

explicitVariableModes.why: variable mode picked for a frame (mobile / desktop values of font size etc.): the REST node holds values of ONE mode, the render of the other can differ (Banner mobile button 14px, REST says 16)

exportSettings.why: export presets for the designer, not part of the node

exposedInstances.why: editor: instances shown in the parent panel

fillGeometry.why: path data of the fills: vectors reach the template as the svg file Figma exports

fillOverrideTable.why: per-vertex fill overrides of vectors: the svg export has them

flowStartingPoints.why: prototype flow entry points: describe click paths, not how a frame looks

gridAutoTracks.why: not in the published spec; GRID tracks are read from gridColumnsSizing / gridRowsSizing

gridItemsPositioning.why: not in the published spec; cell positions are read from the per-child grid keys

isExposedInstance.why: editor: instance exposed in the parent panel

isFixed.why: layer fixed while the page scrolls (position: fixed): not reproduced

isMaskOutline.why: mask drawn as outline: not reproduced

itemReverseZIndex.why: stacking order of auto-layout children (first on top instead of last on top): not applied, the DOM order decides

lineIndentations.why: level of each list line, read together with lineTypes

lineTypes.why: unordered first-level lists are built as ul/li by text.mjs (indent 1.5em, bullet ink at 0.594em); ordered and nested lists are reported by the text rule

locked.why: editor lock that stops the designer from moving the layer, no visual effect

maskType.why: kind of mask (ALPHA / VECTOR / LUMINANCE): masks are only handled as a flat picture by Figma export

overflowDirection.why: scrolling overflow of a frame (prototype scroll area): not built as a scroll container

overrides.why: list of instance overrides: the REST node already holds the overridden values

pluginData.why: private storage of a Figma plugin, no visual effect

preserveRatio.why: only decides how the layer scales when the designer resizes it

prototypeStartNodeID.why: prototype flow start frame: describes click paths, not how a frame looks

scrollBehavior.why: prototype scroll behaviour, no visual effect on the static design

shapeType.why: FigJam only: which shape a shape-with-text node draws, never present on a design frame

sharedPluginData.why: storage shared between Figma plugins, no visual effect

strokeCap.why: end shape of an open stroke (ROUND, ARROW...): lines are drawn as a box + border, they have no cap

strokeGeometry.why: path data of the strokes: same, through the svg export

strokeJoin.why: corner shape of a stroke (MITER default): CSS borders have square corners and shadows follow the radius

targetAspectRatio.why: aspect-ratio lock used while the designer resizes

uniformScaleFactor.why: scale tool factor used while the designer resizes

vectorNetwork.why: vector editing network: same, through the svg export

fontVariations.why: variable-font axes (opsz, wdth, slnt...): the page loads the static weights from Google Fonts

hangingList.why: list markers hanging outside the text box, see node.lineTypes

hangingPunctuation.why: punctuation hanging outside the text box: CSS hanging-punctuation is not supported by Chromium

hyperlink.why: a link on a text run: the build has no per-run link (links are decided per element, URL is a designer-list item)

inheritFillStyleId.why: id of the fill style the run inherits from: the resolved fills are in the run

inheritTextStyleId.why: id of the text style the run inherits from: the resolved values are in the run

isOverrideOverTextStyle.why: says the run overrides a text style; its values are in the run itself

leadingTrim.why: trims the text box to the cap height / baseline: changes the box height, not written

listSpacing.why: spacing between list items of a list text; lists are not built (see node.lineTypes)

opentypeFlags.why: OpenType features (ligatures, tabular numbers, small caps...): not written to font-feature-settings

semanticItalic.why: accessibility label of the italic: `italic` / fontStyle are read

semanticWeight.why: accessibility label of the weight (BOLD / NORMAL): the numeric fontWeight is read

SMALL_CAPS.why: small capitals for lower-case letters (OpenType smcp): reproducible with font-variant-caps: small-caps, not mapped yet

SMALL_CAPS_FORCED.why: small capitals for every letter: reproducible with font-variant-caps: all-small-caps, not mapped yet

TRUNCATE.why: deprecated Figma value for a text box that truncates with an ellipsis (the same as textTruncation ENDING): not mapped to the line clamp yet

BOTTOM.why: text pinned to the bottom of a fixed-height box: text.mjs reports it, flex alignment of the text inside its own box is not written

ALPHA.why: alpha mask: masked groups are only reproduced as the flat picture Figma exports

LUMINANCE.why: luminance mask: masked groups are only reproduced as the flat picture Figma exports
